button{margin-top:8px}#controls{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:min(100%,960px);gap:14px;user-select:none}.group{display:flex;gap:12px}.ctl{width:70px;height:58px;background:linear-gradient(#394258,#1d2334);color:#fff;border:2px solid #fb9834;border-radius:14px;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px #0005,0 2px 0 #0007}.ctl:active,.ctl.pressed{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px /* EDICIÓN MÓVIL: panel inicial y botones siempre accesibles */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
 html,body{height:100%;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:none}
 #app{min-height:100dvh;height:auto;justify-content:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:12px 10px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
 header{width:100%;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px}
 header h1{font-size:clamp(15px,4vw,20px);line-height:1.22}
 header .sub{font-size:10px;line-height:1.25}
 header>div:last-child{font-size:9px;max-width:120px}
 #wrap{width:100%;border-width:2px;border-radius:10px}
 #controls{width:100%;gap:6px;align-items:center}
 #controls .group{gap:6px;flex:1;justify-content:space-between}
 .ctl,.ctl[style]{width:clamp(49px,14vw,78px)!important;height:clamp(60px,17vw,76px)!important;padding:8px 4px;font-size:25px!important;min-width:0;flex:1}
 footer{display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;padding:0 7px}
 #overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 12px) 12px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px);overflow-y:auto;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overscroll-behavior:contain}
 .panel{width:min(100%,430px);max-width:430px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px - env(safe-area-inset-top) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;overflow:auto}
 .panel img{max-height:60px!important;height:60px!important;flex-shrink:1}
 .panel h2{font-size:clamp(20px,5.6vw,26px);margin:4px 0}
 .panel p{font-size:clamp(12px,3.5vw,15px);line-height:1.32;margin:7px 0;max-height:38dvh;overflow:auto}
 .panel #start{position:static;display:block;flex-shrink:0;width:min(260px,100%);font-size:20px;padding:13px 12px;margin:10px auto 8px;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #0007}
}
@media(max-width:700px) and (max-height:520px){
 header,footer{display:none!important}
 #app{padding:2px 8px 4px;gap:3px;justify-content:flex-start}
 #wrap{max-width:min(100%,720px)}
 #controls{max-width:720px}
 .ctl,.ctl[style]{height:48px!important;width:60px!important}
 .panel{max-height:96dvh}.panel img{height:35px!important}.panel p{max-height:24dvh;font-size:12px}
}

/* V7.9: ajuste universal para teléfonos girados y pantallas de poca altura.
   Reservar 54px para controles; el canvas ocupa SOLO el espacio restante. */
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
 body{overflow:hidden}
 #app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(78px,15vw) 1fr minmax(150px,26vw);grid-template-rows:1fr;align-items:center;justify-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px;min-height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh}
 header,footer{display:none}
 #wrap{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;width:auto;max-width:calc(100vw - minmax(78px,15vw) - minmax(150px,26vw));max-width:min(1000px, calc(100vw - 250px));height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 10px);border-width:3px;justify-self:center;align-self:center}
 canvas{width:auto;height:auto;max-width:min(1000px, calc(100vw - 250px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 10px);aspect-ratio:16/9}
 #controls{display:contents}
 #controls .movement-group,#controls .action-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;align-self:center}
 #controls .movement-group{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
 #controls .action-group{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}
 .ctl{width:68px;height:68px;font-size:28px;padding:0}
 #controls .action-group .ctl{width:72px;height:60px}
 #overlay{padding:10px}
 .panel{max-width:min(480px,76vw);max-height:88dvh;padding:14px}
 .panel p{font-size:clamp(11px,2.3vw,14px)}
 #officialLogo{max-height:50px!important;width:min(240px,55vw)!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
 #app{grid-template-columns:74px 1fr 136px;gap:6px;padding:2px}
 .ctl{width:60px;height:60px;font-size:24px}
 #controls .action-group .ctl{width:62px;height:50px}
 #wrap{max-width:min(1000px, calc(100vw - 220px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 6px)}
 canvas{max-width:min(1000px, calc(100vw - 220px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 6px)}
 .panel{padding:10px;max-height:92dvh}
 .panel h2{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,24px)}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (min-width:900px) and (pointer:coarse){
 .ctl{width:76px;height:76px}
 #controls .action-group .ctl{width:82px;height:64px}
}


/* V8.1: pantalla completa y aprovechamiento de espacio; solo presentación */
#fullscreenBtn{background:#30364d;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fb9834}
#fullscreenBtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
 #app{grid-template-columns:clamp(62px,8vw,84px) minmax(0,1fr) clamp(104px,14vw,132px);column-gap:3px;padding:2px;}
 #wrap{width:100%;height:auto;max-width:none;max-height:calc(100dvh - 4px);aspect-ratio:16/9;}
 canvas{width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:contain;}
 #controls .movement-group{gap:9px}
 #controls .action-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;width:100%;padding:2px}
 #controls .action-group .ctl,#controls .action-group .ctl[style],#controls .movement-group .ctl{width:100%!important;min-width:0;height:clamp(45px,15dvh,66px)!important;padding:0;font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,27px)}
 #fullscreenBtn{grid-column:1 / -1}
}
@media (display-mode:fullscreen) and (orientation:landscape){
 html,body,#app{height:100dvh;width:100vw;margin:0}
}

/* V8.2 retro NES */
#controls .action-group{align-items:center}
#controls .action-group #jump,#controls .action-group #taunt{font-family:Arial Black,system-ui,sans-serif}
@media (max-width:700px){
 #jump,#taunt{width:clamp(60px,17vw,78px)!important;height:clamp(60px,17vw,78px)!important;font-size:clamp(24px,7vw,31px)!important}
 #pause{font-size:11px!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
 #controls .action-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px;width:100%;padding:2px}
 #controls .action-group #jump,#controls .action-group #taunt{width:100%!important;height:clamp(48px,16dvh,74px)!important}
 #controls .action-group #pause{grid-column:1 / -1;font-size:12px!important;height:clamp(34px,10dvh,48px)!important}
 #soundBtn,#musicBtn,#fullscreenBtn{font-size:18px!important}
}

/* V8.2.3 D-pad NES para flechas */
.movement-group{--dpad-btn:68px;position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--dpad-btn) 18px var(--dpad-btn);grid-template-rows:18px var(--dpad-btn) 18px;gap:0;align-items:center;justify-items:center;min-width:calc(var(--dpad-btn)*2 + 18px);min-height:calc(var(--dpad-btn) + 36px)}
.movement-group::before,.movement-group::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:linear-gradient(#323949,#171c28);border:2px solid #9aa3b6;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #0005,0 2px 0 #0007;border-radius:12px}
.movement-group::before{width:44px;height:calc(var(--dpad-btn) + 28px);z-index:0}
.movement-group::after{width:calc(var(--dpad-btn)*2 + 22px);height:44px;z-index:0}
#controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{position:relative;z-index:2;width:var(--dpad-btn);height:var(--dpad-btn);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(#3a4253,#181d2b);border:2px solid #b7bfce;color:#f5f7ff;font-size:30px;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #0005,0 2px 0 #0007}
#controls .movement-group #left{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
#controls .movement-group #right{grid-column:3;grid-row:2}
#controls .movement-group #left:active,#controls .movement-group #right:active,#controls .movement-group #left.pressed,#controls .movement-group #right.pressed{transform:translateY(2px);background:#e78a20;color:#111;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #0005,0 1px 0 #0007}
@media (max-width:700px){.movement-group{--dpad-btn:62px}}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{--dpad-btn:72px;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:var(--dpad-btn) 16px var(--dpad-btn);grid-template-rows:16px var(--dpad-btn) 16px;align-self:center;justify-self:center}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{--dpad-btn:60px}
}

/* V8.2.4 ajuste de cruceta para que no se salga en horizontal */
@media (orientation:landscape) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{padding-left:max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right));}
  #controls .movement-group{justify-self:end!important;align-self:center;margin-left:10px;transform:translateX(8px);}
  #controls .action-group{justify-self:start!important;align-self:center;}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{--dpad-btn:64px!important;grid-template-columns:var(--dpad-btn) 14px var(--dpad-btn)!important;grid-template-rows:14px var(--dpad-btn) 14px!important;min-width:calc(var(--dpad-btn)*2 + 14px);}
  .movement-group::before{width:38px;height:calc(var(--dpad-btn) + 20px)}
  .movement-group::after{width:calc(var(--dpad-btn)*2 + 14px);height:38px}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{font-size:27px}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{--dpad-btn:56px!important;transform:translateX(4px)}
  .movement-group::before{width:34px;height:calc(var(--dpad-btn) + 16px)}
  .movement-group::after{width:calc(var(--dpad-btn)*2 + 10px);height:34px}
}

/* V8.2.5: quitar cruceta y dejar dos botones retro más adentro */
.movement-group::before,.movement-group::after{display:none!important;content:none!important}
.movement-group{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;gap:12px!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;min-width:auto!important;min-height:auto!important}
#controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{position:relative;grid-column:auto!important;grid-row:auto!important;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(#3a4253,#181d2b);border:2px solid #b7bfce;color:#f5f7ff;font-size:28px;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #0005,0 2px 0 #0007}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,20vw) 1fr minmax(150px,26vw)!important;column-gap:10px!important;padding-left:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-right));}
  #controls .movement-group{justify-self:center!important;transform:translateX(12px)!important;margin-left:0!important;}
  #controls .action-group{justify-self:start!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{gap:10px!important;transform:translateX(16px)!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:58px!important;height:58px!important;font-size:24px!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:minmax(132px,18vw) 1fr minmax(132px,24vw)!important;column-gap:6px!important}
  #controls .movement-group{gap:8px!important;transform:translateX(12px)!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:54px!important;height:54px!important;font-size:22px!important}
}
@media (max-width:700px){
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:60px;height:60px}
}

/* V8.2.6: volver al layout de la segunda imagen: flechas pequeñas, verticales y estilo NES */
@media (orientation:landscape) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,12vw) 1fr minmax(170px,26vw)!important;column-gap:10px!important;padding-left:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-right));}
  #controls .movement-group{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:12px!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;justify-self:center!important;align-self:center!important;transform:none!important;margin:0!important;min-width:auto!important;min-height:auto!important}
  #controls .movement-group::before,#controls .movement-group::after{display:none!important;content:none!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:52px!important;height:84px!important;border-radius:20px!important;background:linear-gradient(#3a4253,#181d2b)!important;border:2px solid #aeb7c9!important;color:#f3f6ff!important;font-size:26px!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000!important;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #0005,0 2px 0 #0007!important;grid-column:auto!important;grid-row:auto!important;position:relative!important}
  #controls .action-group{justify-self:start!important;align-self:center!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .movement-group{gap:10px!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:48px!important;height:74px!important;font-size:24px!important;border-radius:18px!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:minmax(82px,11vw) 1fr minmax(160px,24vw)!important;column-gap:8px!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:44px!important;height:66px!important;font-size:22px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
}

/* V8.2.7 FINAL: layout como la segunda imagen, flechas pequeñas verticales con look retro */
@media (orientation:landscape) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(165px,25vw)!important;column-gap:8px!important;padding-left:max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right));}
  #controls .movement-group{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:12px!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;justify-self:center!important;align-self:center!important;transform:none!important;margin:0!important;min-width:52px!important;min-height:auto!important}
  #controls .movement-group::before,#controls .movement-group::after{display:none!important;content:none!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:42px!important;height:72px!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:linear-gradient(#384255,#171c29)!important;border:2px solid #9ca6bb!important;color:#f3f6ff!important;font-size:22px!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000!important;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 #0005,0 2px 0 #0007!important;grid-column:auto!important;grid-row:auto!important;position:relative!important;padding:0!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left:active,#controls .movement-group #right:active,#controls .movement-group #left.pressed,#controls .movement-group #right.pressed{transform:translateY(2px)!important;background:#e78a20!important;color:#111!important;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #0005,0 1px 0 #0007!important}
  #controls .action-group{justify-self:start!important;align-self:center!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(160px,24vw)!important;column-gap:6px!important}
  #controls .movement-group{gap:10px!important;min-width:48px!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:40px!important;height:64px!important;font-size:20px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:430px) and (pointer:coarse){
  #app{grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr) 150px!important;column-gap:5px!important}
  #controls .movement-group{gap:8px!important;min-width:44px!important}
  #controls .movement-group #left,#controls .movement-group #right{width:36px!important;height:58px!important;font-size:18px!important;border-radius:14px!important}

/* V8.2.8: reordenar botones derechos para control más cómodo */
@media (orientation:landscape) and (pointer:coarse){
  #controls .action-group{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(56px,1fr))!important;grid-template-areas:'fs fs' 'sound music' 'start start' 'jump taunt'!important;gap:10px!important;align-items:center!important;justify-items:center!important;width:min(170px,25vw)!important}

 }
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px) and (pointer:coarse){

  #fullscreenBtn{height:48px!important;font-size:22px!important}

 }

  #fullscreenBtn{height:40px!important;font-size:20px!important}
  #soundBtn,#musicBtn{height:48px!important;font-size:20px!important}
  #pause{height:34px!important;min-width:76px!important;font-size:10px!important}

 }

/* V8.9 — cierre festivo: se activa solo en la pantalla de victoria */
#overlay.victoria .panel{position:relative;isolation:isolate;border-color:#ffb34d;box-shadow:0 0 24px #ee9c4e90,0 8px 30px #000a;animation:victoriaPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
#overlay.victoria .panel::before{content:'🎸  🍕  🐕  🍺  🎉';display:block;font-size:clamp(19px,4vw,28px);letter-spacing:.18em;margin:0 auto 6px;animation:fiestaBob 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}

@keyframes fiestaBob{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes victoriaPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 16px #ee9c4e80,0 8px 30px #000a}50%{box-shadow:0 0 30px #e8a043bd,0 8px 30px #000a}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#overlay.victoria .panel,#overlay.victoria .panel::before{animation:none}}

/* V9.0: presentación arcade; no modifica controles ni lógica */

/* V16.1: celebración animada; no afecta físicas ni controles. */
